notes: Event date: 23 October 1944 (Siegfried p226: "only a day after the 104th Division first had moved into the line" on 24 October; the same page gives 1,400 casualties in its first action in the Netherlands). Event definition: the 104th Division, attached to the Canadian First Army, fights under Canadian First Army and British I Corps; the row dates its first entry into the line. Relationship: British I Corps operational_control and Canadian First Army operational_control from 15 October to 4 November (CMH table); Ninth Army administrative control.
